4125-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4125-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1987-7874-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-7874-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}.
The Immortal Weapons triggers, giving a creature +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Immortal Weapons.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-7874-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

4644-4734-7791.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Cradle Clearcutter.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

2033-4885-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-4885-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-4885-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

413-6602--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3698-4559-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two lands enter this turn.
3698-4559-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
3698-4559-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
When the Mutagens enter, Grinding Station triggers that many times, untapping Grinding Station
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 3.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-5686-7216.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

4659-5320-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
4659-5320-6753.description:
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
4659-5320-6753.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

997-2842-4681-5170.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

104-3490-5231-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
104-3490-5231-6458.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

792-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
792-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

222-527-5223-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5223-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

2921-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
2921-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4205-4613.description:
Activate Bloodthirsty Aerialist by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Bloodthirsty Aerialist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1329-3169-4050-5129.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than one plus Emry's commander tax.
1329-3169-4050-5129.description:
Cast Genesis Chamber by paying {2}.
When Genesis Chamber enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Genesis Chamber.
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

1429-4875-5330-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4875-5330-5402.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2393-4050-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2781-3277-4617-4906-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
2781-3277-4617-4906-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Izzet Chronarch, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

654-4974-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-4974-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-4974-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1671-2178-4913-5310.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
1671-2178-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast.
When Bloodghast dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3858-3988.notablePrerequisites: Rootwire Amalgam has a power of seven or greater.
3858-3988.description:
Activate Rootwire Amalgam by paying {3}{G}{G} and sacrificing it, creating a 21/21 (or larger) Golem artifact creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

1363-2059-3593.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
You control at least one additional creature.
Tradewind Rider does not have summoning sickness.
1363-2059-3593.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Village Bell-Ringer from your hand onto the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Village Bell-Ringer, and one other creature you control, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2724-4991-5207.notablePrerequisites: Nightscape Apprentice does not have summoning sickness.
2724-4991-5207.description:
Tap Nightscape Apprentice for {U} to put Wormfang Manta on top of your library.
Wormfang Manta's LTB triggers, granting you an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Whisperwood Elemental triggers, manifesting Wormfang Manta.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn it face up.
Repeat for infinite turns.
